prompt: If 7 printers take 7 minutes to print 7 posters, how many minutes would 21 printers take to print 21 posters?
trap_note: Scaling printers and posters together leaves the per-printer rate unchanged, so the time is unchanged. The trap answer is 21 -- produced by treating the ratio as if only the workload had tripled.
